# SignGRU evaluation (auto-generated by `training/evaluate.py`)

All numbers below are measured on **ASL Citizen test-split signers** that were never used for training or checkpoint selection. The enabled vocabulary was chosen on validation signers, with one exception: signs in the manual-disable list were removed after a test run showed they failed (this only removes claims; it cannot inflate the enabled-sign numbers for other signs). Clips are short isolated-sign webcam recordings; live performance with a different signer, camera and lighting can be lower.

- Test clips: **2755** from **11** signers
- Central-window top-1 accuracy over all 162 classes (incl. unknown): **74.0%**
- Central-window top-1 accuracy on target-sign clips only: **73.1%**
- Models: signgru_v2.pt, signgru_v2_s1.pt, signgru_v2_s2.pt, signgru_v2_s3.pt, signgru_v2_s4.pt (probabilities averaged)
- Streaming replay pads each clip with 1500 ms of rest before and 1000 ms after (signer in frame, hands down), as in live use
- Enable rule: validation-signer streaming recall >= 0.5 and precision >= 0.6 at threshold 0.6; manually disabled: GOOD
- Enabled signs: **AFTERNOON, ALL, ASK, BAD, BATHROOM, BIG, BUSY, BYE, CALL1, CALL2, CAN1, COFFEE, COME, COMPUTER, DAY, DEAF1, DIFFERENT, DONTKNOW, DONTLIKE, DRINK1, DRINK2, EAT1, EMAIL, ENGLISH, EXCITED, EXCUSE, FAMILY, FAST, FEEL, FINISH, FREE, FRIEND, GO, HAPPY, HAVE, HEAR1, HEAR2, HEARING, HELLO, HELP, HOME, HOPE, HOUR, HOW1, HOW2, HURT, IMPORTANT, INTERPRETER, KNOW, LANGUAGE, LATER, LEARN, LIKE, LOVE, MAN, MANY, MAYBE, ME, MEET, MEETING, MISS, MORE, MORNING, MY, NAME, NEED, NEW, NICE, NO, NOT, NOTHING1, NOTHING2, NOW, OK, OLD, PERSON, PHONE, PLEASE, PROBLEM1, PROBLEM2, READ, READY, REMEMBER1, REMEMBER2, RIGHT1, RIGHT2, RIGHT3, SAD, SAME1, SAME2, SEE, SHARE, SHOW, SICK, SIGN, SORRY, START, STOP, STUDENT, TALK1, TALK2, TEACH1, TEACH2, TEACHER, TELL, THEY1, THEY2, TIME, TIRED, TODAY, TRUE, UNDERSTAND, VOICE, WAIT, WATCH, WATER, WE, WEEK, WELCOME1, WHAT2, WHEN, WHERE, WHICH, WHO, WHY, WILL, WORK, WRONG, YES, YESTERDAY, YOU, YOUR**

## Streaming replay (live code path, enabled signs only)

Each test clip's landmarks are replayed frame-by-frame through the same buffer → model → stabilizer used by the server. A clip counts as correct when the *first* emitted caption is the right sign.

- Correct first caption: **65.6%** of 1628 enabled-sign clips
- Clips of *other, unsupported* signs that triggered any caption: **6.8%** of 789
